§6Machine type: §aArtificial SpaceTime Fabricator§r

A little start of Genesis.
Activate the primordial singularity to begin the creation process of the universe, of course, within controllable limits.
Upgrading the T2 Field blocks enables perfect overclock, and further upgrades can significantly increase the running speed.
But the use of advanced Field blocks requires the use of advanced structure casing block at the same time. Otherwise, it will cause calamity.
Can provide space-time seeds in dedicated input bus, consuming 1 space-time seed per run and doubling the output.

[note]Hatches[/note]: Input Bus, Input Hatch, Output Bus, Output Hatch, Energy Hatch
Use a Hologram Projector (or the NEI structure preview) to see and auto-build the structure.
